Dev.ResolutionHint.message: The game selects SD (.tex) or HD (_hr1.tex). Hover over a title to see the dimensions.

Dev.Resolutions.message: Each ID has SD (.tex, 1280 x 360) and HD (_hr1.tex, 2560 x 720). The game selects the resolution.

Dev.PreviewHint.message: Click a radio button to show the banner. Click it again to repeat.

Coverage.Unavailable.message: This pack has no expansion breakdown.

Part.PlaceNames.Tooltip.message: Names of regions, zones and locations on maps and inside dungeons and other instances.

Part.GoldSaucer.Tooltip.message: Text for GATEs, arcade games, chocobo racing, Triple Triad cards, Lord of Verminion and Doman Mahjong.

Parts.Intro.message: Untick a part and it goes back to English at the next start. Hover a box for what it covers.

Parts.NextStart.message: Changes here take effect when the game next starts.

Restart.Parts.message: You changed which parts are translated. The game reads all of its text once, at startup, so this takes effect the next time it starts.

Pack.Off.message: The game is showing its own text. The installed language pack is switched off.

Pack.Pending.message: A language pack is installed but not in use yet. Restart the game.

Pack.None.message: No language pack installed. Choose a language below and press Install.

Update.Checking.message: Checking whether a newer language pack is published...

Update.Available.message: A newer language pack is published: {0}

Update.Unreachable.message: No connection to the language pack update URL. If it persists, this pack will not update itself, so check where you got it from.

Update.NotDeclared.message: This language pack has no update URL, so it will never update itself.

Setup.UseFolderTip.message: Serves the folder in place. Press again after a rebuild.

Update.MoveTip.message: The pack moved. Reinstall from the new address to keep receiving updates.

Setup.OwnWrongPatch.message: {0}, built for game {1}. The game is running {2}, so it will be refused at startup rather than served. Rebuild it.

Setup.Unbuilt.message: No language pack available. Want to help translate it?

Restart.Serving.message: You changed the language. The game reads all of its text once, at startup, so this takes effect the next time it starts.

Boot.NotWaiting.message: Dalamud is not waiting for plugins at startup, so nothing is fetched then. Turn it on in Dalamud's settings.

Boot.WhereTip.message: It is on the General tab, called "Wait for plugins before game loads".

Pack.Served.message: {0} read(s) answered from disk this session

Pack.Fonts.message: {0} of {1} font file(s) served from the pack

Setup.PickerTitle.message: Select the folder your language pack was built into

Restart.Installed.message: The new language pack is installed but the game will not read it until it starts again, because it loads all of its text once, at startup.

Group.Other.Tooltip.message: Text this pack translates that this build of the plugin has no name for, listed under the game's own name for it. A pack in another language may well cover things this one does not.

Group.Other.PartDesc.message: This build of the plugin has no name for this one.

Group.Story.Tooltip.message: Quest dialogue, objectives, titles and cutscene subtitles.

Part.QuestText.Tooltip.message: Quest conversations, journal entries, objectives and levequest descriptions.

Part.Cutscenes.Tooltip.message: Translates the subtitle lines at the bottom of the screen during voiced cutscenes.

Part.QuestNames.Tooltip.message: Translates only the quest titles (in the tracker, the journal and the Unending Journey).

Part.Talk.Tooltip.message: NPC dialogue outside quests, speech balloons and shouts, including combat shouts. NPC service conversations are under Interface menus.

Group.Duties.Tooltip.message: Duty objectives, dialogue and special combat systems.

Part.DutyText.Tooltip.message: Dialogue, announcements and objectives in duties, FATEs and field operations, plus Variant Dungeon route choices.

Part.Objects.Name.message: Objects and information in the world

Part.Objects.Tooltip.message: What a mechanism or lever tells you when used, plus documents, letters, signs and puzzle hints.

Part.DeepDungeons.Tooltip.message: Pomanders, aetherpool equipment, floor effects, demiclones and incense.

Part.DutyFinder.Tooltip.message: Duty Finder entries, roulette names and descriptions. Entry NPC menus are under Interface menus.

Group.Interface.Tooltip.message: Windows, settings, shops and NPC services in one part.

Part.Interface.Tooltip.message: Buttons, settings, shops, retainers, travel and duty entry menus. Includes NPC topic menus and their dialogue and lore answers because each sheet is switched as a whole.

Group.Chat.Tooltip.message: Combat logs, notifications and error messages.

Part.Log.Tooltip.message: Combat messages, emotes, invitations, system notices and connection errors.

Part.Log.Warning.message: Combat parsers and plugins may depend on English log messages.

Part.Items.Tooltip.message: The names of every item in the bags and on the market board, and the names and descriptions of attributes (Strength, Critical Hit, etc.).

Codex.Enable.message: Enable Unending Codex links on dialog

Codex.Login.message: Log in to use the Unending Codex.

Codex.None.message: No unlocked Codex entries are available.

Codex.Ready.message: Ready. Open a dialogue that names a Codex entry.

Codex.Failed.message: Codex links are unavailable. See /xllog for details.

Part.Lore.Tooltip.message: The Unending Codex, Occult Record and Variant Dungeon records.

Group.World.Tooltip.message: Conversations, speech balloons, readable objects and lore records.

Part.TargetNames.Tooltip.message: Names of enemies, pets, aetherytes and objects you can select. Travel menus are under Interface menus.

Part.TargetNames.Warning.message: Plugins that search for English object names may fail to find translated targets.

Group.Names.Tooltip.message: Names shown on maps and on characters and objects.

Part.Actions.Tooltip.message: Job names, action names and descriptions, traits and status effects.

Group.Combat.Tooltip.message: Actions, effects, attributes and item information.

Part.FieldSystems.Tooltip.message: Phantom jobs and traits in the Occult Crescent, and Eureka aether items.

Part.Crafting.Tooltip.message: Delivery requirements for the Crystalline Mean, Studium and Wachumeqimeqi.

Part.Beastmaster.Tooltip.message: Beast descriptions, Crucible equipment, action properties and score objectives.

Group.Activities.Tooltip.message: Minigames, crafting deliveries and Beastmaster content.

Part.Guides.Tooltip.message: Active Help, job gauge guides and built-in manuals for combat, housing, minigames and exploration.

Group.Guides.Tooltip.message: Help pages and explanations of game systems.

Part.Interface.Warning.message: Plugins that read English buttons or menus may not recognize translated options. This also affects travel and NPC service automation.
